_doc: Reference priors for agent/sim.py. Every service-time field is UNMEASURED: a derivation from public specs, to be replaced by H2/H3 measurements on this host. Fields marked VERIFIED were read from the host or from Intel ARK. compute = engine-seconds per unit at full frequency (phi=1); on P/E pools that is core-seconds; bytes = DRAM bytes moved per unit (GB).

package._pl1_w: VERIFIED host: /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/constraint_0_power_limit_uw = 117000000 (constraint_0_max_power_uw = 35000000; ARK: Processor Base Power 35 W, Maximum Turbo Power 106 W)
package._base_w: UNMEASURED prior: uncore + idle cores + ring. Probe: RAPL package power at idle.
package._dvfs_exponent: prior: dynamic power ~ f * V^2 with V roughly linear in f over the turbo range
package._dram_gbps: UNMEASURED prior: ARK max 89.6 GB/s (2ch DDR5-5600); host has 128 GB (likely 2 DIMMs/channel, lower MT/s) and DIMM speed is root-only (dmidecode). Probe: STREAM triad.

P._: VERIFIED 8 P-cores (cpu_core/cpus 0-15 incl. SMT); watts UNMEASURED

igpu._: VERIFIED UHD 770, 32 EU, rcs0 present; watts UNMEASURED

vcs._: VERIFIED vcs0+vcs1 under /sys/class/drm/card0/engine; ARK: 2 multi-format codec engines

_e_core_perf: UNMEASURED prior: E-core throughput per core relative to a P-core (Gracemont vs Golden Cove IPC x 3.9/5.1 GHz max turbo, ARK)
_spin_penalty: UNMEASURED prior: a thread group oversubscribed to share s<1 of its threads' cores runs at s^(1+spin_penalty) (spin-waiting barrier threads burn their share)

workload._: prefill_tokens = new tokens per turn with prefix caching (retrieved docs + last tool output); decode ends in one tool call

rerank._: 278M cross-encoder x 300 tokens = 167 GFLOP/doc; P ~230 GOP/s/core effective, iGPU ~0.7 TOP/s effective (40% of 32 EU x 1.65 GHz FP16/DP4A peak)

llm_prefill._: 3B Q4 (~1.9 GB): 6 GFLOP/token; weights re-read once per 512-token ubatch

llm_decode._: bytes = KV cache per step at ~4k context; shared_bytes = weights, read once per batched step

media._: 10 s 1080p clip: software decode on 4 cores vs fixed-function vcs
